name: Insidr.ai

sources.title: Homepage — AI tools directory ('500+ AI tools in 78+ categories') with 'Submit AI Tool' links
Submit AI Tools page — Elementor form; 'Submit new AI tools that we should include. If approved, we will add it to our AI Tools directory.'

requirements: AI tools only — directory covers 78+ AI categories
Suggestion-style submission: 'If approved, we will add it' — editorial approval required, listing not guaranteed
Form fields observed: link to the AI tool (they ask for an affiliate-signup link 'if possible'), tool category, and a message
preparation: Tool URL — ideally including an affiliate signup link (the field explicitly asks for one)
Tool category matching their taxonomy (AI for Business, Marketing, SEO, Video, Image & Art, Chatbots, etc.)
workflow: Open https://www.insidr.ai/submit-tools/ (linked as 'Submit AI Tool' throughout the site)
Fill the Elementor form: tool link, category, message
Submit — no account required; the form is a plain POST form
If approved, the tool is added to the AI Tools Directory
watchFor: Field labels are mismatched with placeholders (a 'name' field asks for the tool link, an 'email' field asks for category) — fill by placeholder intent
Paid promotion exists separately ('Want to Promote your AI Tool? Contact us' — directory, newsletter, social media sponsorship)
WordPress/Elementor site — form is simple but heavy pages load slowly
Separate 'Submit AI News' form at /submit-news/ is for news, not listings
countsAsLive: The tool appears as a page/entry in the Insidr.ai AI Tools Directory under a relevant category
unknowns: Review turnaround and acceptance criteria beyond 'if approved'
Whether free listings get a dedicated page vs a link-row, and link type (dofollow/nofollow)
Whether an affiliate link materially improves acceptance odds
